description: This file is a PHP test class (using Codeception framework) for acceptance testing of the CompanyModule in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM environment. It contains test scenarios for creating, viewing, editing, duplicating, and deleting company records through the UI.

classes.name: CompanyModuleCest
classes.description: Acceptance testing class for the Company module in SuiteCRM, implementing scenarios for creating, viewing, editing, duplicating, and deleting company records.

properties.name: fakeData
properties.description: Faker data generator instance used to create fake data for tests.

properties.name: fakeDataSeed
properties.description: Seed value for Faker to produce repeatable fake data.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test to initialize fake data generator with seed.

methods.name: _after
methods.description: Teardown method executed after each test (empty in this case).

methods.name: testScenarioCreateCompanyModule
methods.description: Test scenario for creating the company module using the module builder.

methods.name: testScenarioViewCompanyTestModule
methods.description: Test scenario for viewing the company module list view.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateRecord
methods.description: Test scenario for creating a new company record with fake data.

methods.name: testScenarioViewRecordFromListView
methods.description: Test scenario for searching and viewing a specific company record from list view.

methods.name: testScenarioEditRecordFromDetailView
methods.description: Test scenario for editing an existing company record from its detail view.

methods.name: testScenarioDuplicateRecordFromDetailView
methods.description: Test scenario for duplicating an existing company record.

methods.name: testScenarioDeleteRecordFromDetailView
methods.description: Test scenario for deleting a company record from its detail view.
